newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Indices perk up on Ivory Coast bourse.
newsitem.headline: Indices perk up on Ivory Coast bourse.

text.p: Ivory Coast's stock exchange, the Bourse des Valeurs d'Abidjan (BVA), perked up in the week to Friday, with the two share indices rising, its market report showed.
The BVA All-Share Index, which fell the previous week, rose 1.07 percent to 358.11 points from 354.31 points, taking the 1996 rise to 29.16 percent.
The 12VB 12-share index rose 1.32 percent to 244.32 points from 241.13 points, taking the 1996 rise to 22.62 percent.

Volume, which rose more than fourfold the previous week following the end of the August holiday, rose slightly to 262,985,000 CFA francs from 254,228,000 CFA francs. The number of shares traded fell to 14,891 shares from 21,100.

Rubber producer SOGB (-200 CFA francs to 16,550 CFA) was the main traded share, accounting for 6,312 of shares sold. The main riser was importer and retailer Peyrissac (+2,690 CFA to 28,990). Water utility SODECI, which fell 5,440 CFA francs the previous week after a one for three share issue following a capital increase, rose 1,680 CFA to 18,240 CFA.
